method: XCUITest snapshot frames and Vision text recognition of a screenshot taken right after the snapshot, not at the same instant. noOverlap: no two visible controls' frames cross, apart from a control inside another. controlsOnScreen: no control runs off the screen, or off a scroll view's edge where nothing else in that scroll view starts at or past that edge; a control wholly off screen outside any scroll view is clipped. textFits: every visible label lies inside its container and the screen, and no drawn line ends in an ellipsis unless the label of the element holding it does (so such a label can hide a real truncation). Labels cut by a scroll view's edge are skipped. Text is not compared with other text or with controls.
